Uebersicht.title: Overview
Uebersicht.body:
Your key figures, each with its value, its date and a way into the screen behind it. A tile never shows a false zero.

Arrange key figures and cards here: drag the grip, move with Alt and an arrow key or through More, hide or show with the eye, widen with Resize. Every change is saved at once. The content in My settings sets which cards you start with.

The slim bar of the bank has three symbols: the person for lines that need you, the check mark for sure proposals, the crossed-out paperclip for lines without a receipt. The dot by your bank: green runs, orange waits, red failed, grey is off.
